reasons.text: 2TB for €16 is €8/TB, far below genuine flash storage cost; this matches known fake-capacity drives that report a size they do not have.
Multiple independent failure reports show formatting, recognition, and authenticity problems, with actual capacity far below advertised.
The same product appears under many throwaway brands across AliExpress, eBay, Walmart, and Takealot, indicating a rebrand cycle with no reliable manufacturer support.
